title: Grateful Dead Live at Woodstock Music on 1969-08-16
lineage: Panasonic SV-3700 > Cardas cable S/PDIF > Edirol UA-5 > analog out > Korg MR-1 DFF @ [1bit/2.8 mhz] Rate Conversion: AudioGate to [24bit/96 khz] Mastering: In WaveLab with L3 Waves Multimaximizer > TLH > Flac

ai_review.summary: Historic Woodstock set featuring Pigpen’s marathon Turn On Your Lovelight, but the performance is uneven and recording quality unclear.
ai_review.review: The show is notable mainly for its historical value and a 45‑minute Pigpen‑led rendition of “Turn On Your Lovelight,” which many fans cite as a standout moment. However, reviewers describe the overall performance as below the Dead’s best – citing a dragging “High Time” and uneven pacing – and give no concrete details about audio fidelity, suggesting listeners may need EQ adjustments.

ai_rating.rationale: Average star rating (~3.9) combined with mixed comments on show quality and lack of clear recording feedback yields a solid but not outstanding overall score.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewers do not discuss sound clarity or mix; one mentions using EQ for playback, implying the audio may need enhancement but no specific issues are reported.

show_quality.setlist_flow: The set is praised for its historic jam on “Turn On Your Lovelight,” but overall pacing is considered uneven, with some tracks (e.g., “High Time”) described as dragging and the performance not at the Dead’s peak.
